verdict_rationale: Group 2 overall score of 6.7/10 (equal agent-weight average: a11y=8.31, perf=6.47, test=4.78, dsd=7.33) is pulled down decisively by test-architect findings (avg 4.78/10) which expose structural gaps in the coverage gate, zero-test PHI/patient-banner components, and 18 form-associated components without ElementInternals lifecycle tests. The library scores well on accessibility patterns (8.31/10) and design token cascade (7.33/10) but 27 critical-severity findings — concentrated in test coverage and missing token definitions — block READY status. CDN full-bundle at 295 KB gzip vs documented 50 KB budget requires metric clarification and lazy-loading infrastructure before production deployment.

discarded_findings.reason: Factually incorrect — verified 84 story files contain play: functions; test-architect claim of zero is wrong
discarded_findings.original_finding_excerpt: Zero Storybook story files in packages/hx-library/src/components/ contain a play() function

forced_colors_discrepancy.accessibility_engineer_position: Score 5/10 (high severity): forced-colors support inconsistent — majority of components missing it including hx-button, hx-select, hx-slider, hx-radio-group, hx-tabs, hx-dialog, hx-side-nav, hx-top-nav
forced_colors_discrepancy.design_system_developer_position: Score 8/10 (pass): found @media forced-colors blocks in all 15 audited interactive components including hx-button, hx-select, hx-slider, hx-tabs, hx-dialog, hx-side-nav, hx-top-nav
forced_colors_discrepancy.discrepancy_cause: Sample-set variance — both agents are correct within their review scope. The a11y-engineer evaluated the component source files via pattern search and found inconsistency; the DSD reviewed specific style files in depth and confirmed blocks exist. The discrepancy likely reflects that some components had forced-colors added after the a11y audit was scoped, or that the a11y agent's search pattern missed some blocks.
forced_colors_discrepancy.synthesis_consensus: ~15 components confirmed with forced-colors blocks (DSD sample). ~65 components unreviewed by either agent. True library-wide coverage is estimated at 30-50%. A full audit of all 80 components is required to establish ground truth.

token_naming_bug.detail: 18+ components reference --hx-touch-target-min; hx-alert and hx-banner reference --hx-touch-target-size. Neither name is defined in tokens.json — only --hx-size-touch-target exists. All components fall back to 2.75rem hardcoded values. Theming this property via the documented token API is impossible. Additionally --hx-touch-target-size introduces a third naming variant used in 2 components.
token_naming_bug.recommendation: Standardize on --hx-touch-target-min, add to tokens.json as an alias of --hx-size-touch-target (or rename the canonical token), and update all 20 affected components. Treat as pre-release blocker.

cdn_bundle_finding.detail: The 50 KB budget in bundle-budgets.json is measured by the esbuild analysis script against externalized-Lit per-component output, NOT against the Vite dist full bundle. The 295 KB gzip figure is the real CDN delivery cost when consumers load the full bundle (Strategy A). Both numbers are correct; they measure different things. However, NO CI gate validates either number against the Vite dist output. Additionally, no lazy-loading pattern exists for the CDN path, meaning all 295 KB loads on every Drupal page. This is a real performance risk for the primary delivery mechanism, not merely a documentation issue.
cdn_bundle_finding.healthcare_risk: medium — page load performance in clinical environments where network conditions may be constrained

hx_patient_banner.healthcare_risk: CRITICAL — primary patient identification UI, zero axe-core verification, no slot/PHI rendering tests
hx_patient_banner.regulatory_relevance: HIPAA, Joint Commission patient identification standards

hx_phi_field.healthcare_risk: CRITICAL — PHI masking component, no test confirms PHI is hidden from accessibility tree in masked state, no live region announcement test
hx_phi_field.regulatory_relevance: HIPAA PHI protection, screen reader accessibility of sensitive data

phi_component_risk.combined_assessment: Both PHI components are at CRITICAL risk level for 3.0.0 release. The Group 1 rollup scored both at 10.0 — this was a premature score assigned before test coverage was evaluated. Group 2 test-architect findings reveal they have zero meaningful test coverage. Merged scores (g1+g2 average) of 6.0 and 7.0 respectively do not reflect the severity — recommend manually overriding to CRITICAL tier until test coverage is established.

top_systemic_issues.issue: Test coverage gate is structurally unenforced
top_systemic_issues.detail: coverage-config.json declares a 95% threshold but explicitly exempts 76 of ~80 components, making the coverage gate effectively decorative. 0% lines coverage confirmed for hx-overflow-menu, hx-rating, hx-toast, hx-code-snippet, hx-copy-button. 18 form-associated components lack any ElementInternals lifecycle test (setFormValue, formResetCallback, formStateRestoreCallback).
top_systemic_issues.fix: Remove blanket exemptions on a rolling schedule (max 5 per sprint). Create a shared form-integration test helper exercised from every form-associated component test. Bind exemption removal to qa-engineer-automation feature tickets.

top_systemic_issues.issue: 13 missing token definitions — theming API incomplete
top_systemic_issues.detail: 13 undefined CSS custom property references identified by design-system-developer, across 4 categories: (1) overlay-white steps 15, 25, 50, 70 — 3+ components; (2) size scale gaps: size-1, size-1-5, size-3, size-3-5, size-4-5, size-5-5, size-6-5 — used in hx-switch and hx-slider; (3) space scale gaps: space-0-5, space-1-5 — 8+ components; (4) duration-spinner and opacity-muted — 4 components. Touch-target naming split (--hx-touch-target-min vs --hx-size-touch-target) affects 18+ components. All fall back to hardcoded values — theming is silently broken for these properties.
top_systemic_issues.fix: Single tokens.json patch PR adding all missing tokens before 3.0.0 release. See design-system-developer recommendations for exact values. Treat as pre-release blocker.

top_systemic_issues.issue: PHI and patient-banner components have zero meaningful test coverage
top_systemic_issues.detail: hx-patient-banner has no meaningful tests (coverage-config.json: 'tests to be added'). hx-phi-field is skeleton-only. Neither has axe-core checkA11y() calls. In a healthcare context these are patient safety and regulatory compliance gaps — hx-phi-field controls PHI masking behavior (reveal/mask toggle, live-region announcement, screen-reader accessibility of masked state), and hx-patient-banner is the primary patient identification UI surface.
top_systemic_issues.fix: Treat as P0 test creation: hx-patient-banner needs slot rendering, DOB/MRN display, allergy alert, PHI redaction mode, and axe-core. hx-phi-field needs masked default, toggle reveal, aria-label on toggle state, live region announcement, and confirmation masked state hides PHI from accessibility tree.

top_systemic_issues.issue: CDN full bundle 295 KB gzip vs 50 KB documented budget — metric definition gap
top_systemic_issues.detail: performance-engineer measured the full Vite dist bundle (all 80+ components + shared chunks) at approximately 295 KB gzip, which is 5.8x the 50 KB budget documented in bundle-budgets.json. Root cause is a metric definition ambiguity: the 50 KB budget applies to the esbuild per-component analysis script output (externalized Lit), not to the Vite dist full-bundle artifact. However, no CI gate enforces either measurement against the Vite output. Additionally, the CDN build strategy (build-cdn.mjs Strategy A) loads all components synchronously — no lazy-loading infrastructure exists for the Drupal CDN path. This is not purely a documentation gap: consumers using the full CDN bundle are loading 295 KB on every page regardless of which components are used.
top_systemic_issues.fix: (1) Document which artifact the 50 KB budget applies to and add an automated size-limit check against dist/index.js + shared chunks in CI. (2) Publish Drupal-specific lazy-loading pattern using Strategy B (per-component CDN files) with IntersectionObserver. (3) Provide a withLazyRegistration() helper or lazy entry point for the 4 heaviest overlay components (hx-dialog, hx-drawer, hx-color-picker, hx-date-picker = ~21 KB gzip combined).

top_systemic_issues.detail: sideEffects in package.json marks all component index files as side-effectful, blocking tree-shaking for consumers importing from the barrel. document-token-adoption.js executes at module evaluation time via a bare import in src/index.ts, causing document.adoptedStyleSheets mutation as a side effect of any named import from @helixui/library — including in SSR and test environments. 100 per-component re-imports of document-token-adoption create wide side-effect surface for non-Vite consumer bundlers.
top_systemic_issues.fix: Narrow sideEffects to ['./dist/utilities/document-token-adoption.js', '**/*.css']. Wrap the bare import in src/index.ts with a typeof document guard or move auto-invocation to a separate entry point.

top_systemic_issues.issue: Form-associated component test coverage is library-wide gap
top_systemic_issues.detail: 18 form-associated components identified (hx-button, hx-checkbox, hx-checkbox-group, hx-color-picker, hx-combobox, hx-date-picker, hx-file-upload, hx-icon-button, hx-number-input, hx-radio-group, hx-rating, hx-select, hx-slider, hx-switch, hx-text-input, hx-textarea, hx-time-picker, hx-toggle-button). None have a comprehensive form integration test exercising the full ElementInternals lifecycle. hx-combobox, hx-date-picker, hx-file-upload are marked critical by test-architect for skeleton-only coverage despite being high-frequency healthcare workflow components.
top_systemic_issues.fix: Create shared form-integration test helper (real <form> element, submit, verify FormData, reset, verify clearing). Assign to qa-engineer-automation as a batch feature targeting all 18 components.

top_systemic_issues.issue: Forced-colors coverage — contested between agents, consensus estimate ~60-70%
top_systemic_issues.detail: DISCREPANCY NOTE: accessibility-engineer assessed forced-colors as 'inconsistent across the library' (score: 5/10, severity: high) claiming the majority of components are missing it, citing hx-button, hx-select, hx-combobox, hx-slider, and others. design-system-developer found @media (forced-colors: active) blocks present in all 15 interactive components it audited (hx-button, hx-card, hx-alert, hx-text-input, hx-number-input, hx-select, hx-checkbox, hx-switch, hx-tabs, hx-side-nav, hx-top-nav, hx-slider, hx-toast, hx-dialog) and rated global forced-colors support as 8/10. Root cause of discrepancy: both agents evaluated different component sample sets. The 47 components NOT reviewed by either agent likely have inconsistent coverage. Consensus estimate: ~15 of 80 components confirmed to have forced-colors blocks; the remaining ~65 are unverified. Actual coverage is likely 30-50%, not the 80%+ implied by DSD or the <20% implied by a11y-engineer.
top_systemic_issues.fix: Conduct a library-wide forced-colors audit covering all 80 components. Each interactive component must: (1) use outline not box-shadow for focus rings (box-shadow ignored in forced-colors mode), (2) use system color keywords (ButtonText, HighlightText, CanvasText), (3) not rely solely on background-color to communicate state.

top_systemic_issues.issue: hx-date-picker render performance — 42 closure allocations per focus keystroke
top_systemic_issues.detail: hx-date-picker has 4 compounding render-performance issues: (1) _getDaysInGrid() allocates 42 Date objects per render with no memoization, called on every @state change including focus events; (2) inline arrow function click handlers in _renderDayGrid() create 42 closures per render; (3) toLocaleDateString() called inline per render for each day aria-label (up to 42 format calls per render); (4) setFormValue and _updateValidity run in updated() (post-paint) instead of willUpdate(). In healthcare appointment scheduling contexts this component is used at high frequency.
top_systemic_issues.fix: Move grid computation to willUpdate() with changedProperties-gated cache invalidation. Use a delegated click handler at grid level (read data-day from event target). Memoize day aria-labels. Move setFormValue/updateValidity to willUpdate().

top_systemic_issues.issue: Hardcoded fallback hex values mismatch tokens.json
top_systemic_issues.detail: Multiple components have hardcoded fallback hex values that do not match the corresponding token values in tokens.json: hx-alert info-500 fallback #3b82f6 (token: #0284C7), hx-alert info-800 fallback #1a3a4a (token: #0C4A6E), hx-toast success-600 fallback #16a34a (token: #15803D), hx-toast warning-500 fallback #f59e0b (token: #D97706), hx-badge warning-500 fallback #eab308 (token: #D97706). These cause subtle visual discrepancies when token sheets fail to load (network failure, SSR, test environments).
top_systemic_issues.fix: Run a systematic audit of all hardcoded fallback values against tokens.json. Add a CI check validating fallback hex values match the parent token definition value. Update the 5 confirmed mismatches immediately.

top_systemic_issues.issue: hx-color-picker and hx-counter redundant requestUpdate() scheduling
top_systemic_issues.detail: hx-color-picker calls explicit requestUpdate() inside _updateGridFromPointer(), _updateHueFromPointer(), and _updateOpacityFromPointer() after assigning to @state fields — double-scheduling on every pointermove event during drag. Additionally, _hueColor() and _previewColor() are plain methods called in render() that recompute HSV-to-RGB conversion at pointer-move frequency rather than being cached in willUpdate(). hx-counter uses requestUpdate() in an animation loop without confirming that the @state increment alone would schedule updates.
top_systemic_issues.fix: Remove explicit requestUpdate() calls where @state assignment already schedules updates. Move _hueColor()/_previewColor() computations to willUpdate(). Combine styleMap updates into a single call.

phase4_additions.task: Create comprehensive test files for hx-patient-banner and hx-phi-field as absolute P0 healthcare-mandated coverage. hx-patient-banner: slot rendering, DOB/MRN display, allergy alert visibility, PHI redaction mode, axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA. hx-phi-field: masked default state, toggle reveals PHI, aria-label updates on toggle, live region announces state change, masked state does not expose PHI to accessibility tree, axe-core both masked and revealed states.
phase4_additions.rationale: Both components are zero-tested healthcare-specific UI. PHI masking with no accessibility test is a patient privacy and regulatory risk. Patient banner is the primary patient identification surface — screen-reader inaccessibility is a clinical safety gap.

phase4_additions.task: Add all 13 missing token definitions to packages/hx-tokens/src/tokens.json in a single PR: overlay-white steps 15/25/50/70, size scale entries 1/1-5/3/3-5/4-5/5-5/6-5, space scale entries 0-5/1-5, duration-spinner (750ms, reconcile with progress-ring 1400ms fallback), opacity-muted (0.6), touch-target canonical naming (--hx-touch-target-min). Also fix --hx-lift-md -> --hx-transform-lift-md reference in hx-card.styles.ts.
phase4_additions.rationale: 13 undefined token references mean consumers cannot theme these values despite them being documented in the theming API. The touch-target naming split affects 18+ components. All fall back to hardcoded values — theming is silently broken.

phase4_additions.task: Create a shared form-integration test helper (form-integration.test-helper.ts) that constructs a real <form>, appends each form-associated component, submits, verifies FormData, resets, verifies clearing. Wire this helper into the test files for all 18 form-associated components. Priority order: hx-combobox (CRITICAL), hx-date-picker (CRITICAL), hx-file-upload (CRITICAL), then hx-text-input, hx-select, hx-checkbox, hx-switch, hx-textarea, hx-number-input, hx-slider, hx-time-picker, hx-radio-group.
phase4_additions.rationale: 0 of 18 form-associated components have ElementInternals lifecycle integration tests. Healthcare forms submit patient data — form association correctness is safety-critical.

phase4_additions.task: Resolve CDN bundle budget ambiguity: (1) Document in bundle-budgets.json which artifact the 50 KB budget applies to (esbuild analysis script vs Vite dist). (2) Add CI automated size-limit check against dist/index.js + all shared chunks. (3) Publish lazy-loading pattern in Drupal integration docs using Strategy B (per-component CDN files + IntersectionObserver). (4) Implement or document a withLazyRegistration() pattern for hx-dialog, hx-drawer, hx-color-picker, hx-date-picker.
phase4_additions.rationale: 295 KB gzip CDN full bundle with no lazy-loading means every Drupal page loads the full library regardless of component usage. The heaviest 4 components (modal/overlay) are universally off-screen on load and ideal IntersectionObserver candidates.

phase4_additions.task: Conduct a library-wide forced-colors audit covering all 80 components (the 15 confirmed by DSD + the 65 unverified). Produce a component-by-component forced-colors compliance matrix. For each non-compliant component: (1) replace box-shadow focus rings with outline, (2) apply ButtonText/HighlightText/CanvasText system keywords, (3) ensure state (checked, selected, active, error) is not communicated solely via background-color.
phase4_additions.rationale: Forced-colors support is a WCAG 2.1 1.4.11 requirement and critical for healthcare users in Windows High Contrast mode. The discrepancy between the two agent assessments (covering different sample sets) leaves ~65 components unverified. The consensus estimate is ~30-50% actual coverage.

phase4_additions.task: Optimize hx-date-picker render performance: move _getDaysInGrid() to willUpdate() with changedProperties-gated cache invalidation (_viewYear, _viewMonth, value only). Replace 42 inline click closures in _renderDayGrid() with a delegated click handler reading data-day from event target. Memoize day aria-labels. Move setFormValue/updateValidity calls from updated() to willUpdate().
phase4_additions.rationale: Four compounding render-performance issues cause up to 42 closure allocations and 42 toLocaleDateString() calls per focus keystroke. This component is used at high frequency in healthcare appointment scheduling.

phase4_additions.task: Fix tree-shaking side-effect surface: (1) Narrow sideEffects in package.json to ['./dist/utilities/document-token-adoption.js', '**/*.css']. (2) Wrap bare import of document-token-adoption in src/index.ts with typeof document guard or move to a separate side-effect entry point.
phase4_additions.rationale: Current sideEffects config prevents tree-shaking for any barrel import consumer. The bare document.adoptedStyleSheets mutation at module evaluation time causes issues in SSR and test environments.

Add axe-core checkA11y() tests to hx-button, hx-checkbox, hx-text-input, hx-tooltip, hx-date-picker (all currently have zero axe-core coverage).
phase4_additions.rationale: 8 components at 0% line coverage block the 95% threshold gate from ever being meaningful. axe-core gaps in high-traffic form components (hx-button, hx-checkbox, hx-text-input) are WCAG compliance gaps.
